changePreview.worker

        |-- removals: ghost text / placement / spans

Main thread -> changePreviewText(): display-only projection
|-- current rows + previous labels + red removals
|-- folding filters hidden ghost rows
`-- PreviewTextRow[] -> PreviewTextRun[]
